scope.activation: The original RAG and three-call closed-book majority are different binary Supported/Refuted labels.
scope.nonbinary_memory_policy: Do not call either selector; retain the selected corroboration candidate.

variants.control: Same-model selector sees the sealed internal record, pre-retrieval claim plan, endpoint labels, current champion, and original RAG process counts; stress record is explicitly withheld.
variants.full: The same selector additionally sees anonymous assertion-unit structure and all fixed-context stress outcomes.

action_mapping.trust_rag: Copy the original RAG endpoint label.
action_mapping.trust_memory: Copy the three-call same-model closed-book endpoint label.
action_mapping.keep_champion: Copy the selected low-rate corroboration prediction.

information_hidden: raw retrieved passages and their factual summaries
reporting: Full-system accuracy by victim and rate for both variants.
Paired gains and regressions versus RAG, memory, answerability, and selected corroboration.
Direct full-versus-control comparison to isolate the stress record's contribution.
A deterministic structural-policy ablation derived only after outputs and labeled as post-label development if labels inform it.
